headline: Exchange Intake Falls To 208.4 Million Dollars From 382.2 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, fell to a 208.4 million dollar net inflow, 0.0773 percent of custodied value, from 382.2 million dollars and 0.1419 percent on the prior print. Bitstamp took in 460.5 million dollars while Bitfinex showed a 283.7 million dollar outflow, so one large venue is still receiving dollars as another is sending them out. A positive print means dollars arrived where holders can sell, and a negative print means dollars left that venue.
author: jordan
